items.title: SOMEBODY IS GOOD AT SOMETHING. {{accent}}
items.label: FIG. 01 / IN THE ROOM
items.photo_alt: Window light across a worn couch inside The Mix before the room fills
items.body:
Somebody is good at something. We show up and film it.

That covers a lot. Tattoos, sets, a room at 1am, a guy fixing his own gear in the parking lot. If the work is real, it shoots.

We don't build a set for it. We go where it already happens and stay out of the way. *Mostly.* No plan longer than a night.

Small crew, decent cameras, worse sleep than you.

items.title: A ROOM FULL OF {{accent}}
items.label: ROSTER / NO FILLER
items.photo_alt: A packed room in full red wash at Paper Tiger
items.body:
There's a vampire running the camera. That's Gianni. He quit the day job for this, and he'll stand in a parking lot at 1 AM until he gets the shot.

KAV-MAN raps. Virgo raps a different way, punk on the surface, trap in the bones. Both of them go crazy. Neither one needs us to explain them.

Wrathfol is on the boards. San Antonio by way of Houston, produces anything, and every beat tells a story. Subtle has never once been the move.

Nobody here is well rounded. Everybody was already the best person we know at *exactly one thing.* We stacked the specific ones and aimed them at each other.

Nobody works for anybody.

items.title: NOBODY SITS {{accent}}
items.label: HANDS, NOT HEADS
items.photo_alt: Performer working the mic in green stage wash
items.body:
The interview happens while the subject works. Needle in the skin. Bleach on the foil. Beat loading. They talk, they keep going, we roll.

Two cameras. One on the face and hands, one locked over the shoulder. We don't bring lights. The room already has some.

People say better things when their hands are busy. A sit-down against a wall gets you a press release. We'd rather watch the needle.

Every one gets a number. 0TP-001, 0TP-002, on down.

items.title: THE {{accent}} ARE SHORT
items.label: FIG. 04 / POSTED
items.meta: WE SAY IT BEFORE THE CAMERA COMES OUT
items.photo_alt: Quiet diner booth by the window late at night
items.body:
No comments. No accounts. Nothing to log into. You came to look at the work, not to argue under it.

Off the record stays off the record. Say it, then say don't use it, and it's gone. We don't keep a copy.

The subject sees the cut before anybody else does. Hate it and we fix it or we shelve it. We'd rather lose a story than burn somebody who let us in the room.

We already liked you or the camera wouldn't be out. None of this is a stance. It's just how we'd want to be filmed.
